answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the wander log makes public the live set and the basalt audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 327 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 193 aliases alive therefore means 193 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ember quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
